text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother...
Curren ran well, right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...
Curren ran well, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I nailed the cute pose, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Right? But somehow, something's missing.
I don't feel like I've really captured everyone's hearts...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Why is that?
Are they saying being cute isn't enough?
No, cuteness is invincible. If that's the case...

Curren Chan fell deep into thought.
To my eyes, she seemed to be producing solid results, but...

Even on the way back to Tokyo,
Curren Chan would fall silent from time to time...

"So I thought I'd leave her be for now,
and while checking various social media feeds—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Umatter?
choice_data_list: We've got a lot of reactions to the race coming in.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...'Watched for the first time because Curren was in it.
Sprint races are fun too!' 'Gonna keep an eye on her from now on.'
'Curren Chan is so cute' ...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see. More and more people are starting
to pay attention to short distances.
It's gradual, but it makes me really happy—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look at this comment...
'I couldn't take my eyes off Curren Chan.'
...it says.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Sprint races really are over in the blink of an eye.
Curren-chan dashing right past me in a flash
is still burned into my mind..."
choice_data_list: It's a contest decided in an instant, after all.
It's decided in an instant, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... That's right!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I won't let anyone blink.
Everyone has to hold their breath and watch.
That's why Curren loves short distances!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
One minute is all I need. In just one minute—
I can capture everyone's hearts.
That's what makes sprint races so fun!

Curren Chan's eyes sparkled.
Sprint races seem to suit
her personality perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I don't want to just be an afterimage that fades away after a minute.
I want Curren to be etched into your mind forever."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I want to leave a cute Curren Chan
right in the center of everyone's hearts!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...The next race is the Sprinters Stakes.
I'll need to finish my homework by then."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"To fill everyone's hearts with cuteness...
I have to think about what's needed."
choice_data_list: Let's grab it at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

Next is finally the Sprinters Stakes, our main goal.
It would be great if we could grasp something during the summer training camp beforehand, though...
